notes.title: Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello Pioneer,

We are happy to announce that we have a new update for the demo!
Based on your feedback we added new features and made some improvements - bug fixes, performance, build size....
Expect a smoother frame-rate and a lot more settings you can tweak in the options menu.

Features:
- Map pin
- Look back when driving
- You can now bind dash to a standalone button
- Options updated with settings for shadows, LODs and tree distance
- Trees from unloaded chunks can now be rendered if using a higher render tree distance
- Bus damage is now visible on the model
- Enemies now attack the bus
- Destructible objects added like streetlights, streetlights and boxes, making driving much easier
- Special group of enemies and events where you can risk it for the biscuit
- Turrets!
- New events for the towers
- Changed pick up all items to a single button
- Significantly decreased initial loading time
- Many visual changes to help with readability
- Improved sound performance
- New sounds and ambiances
- Full controller support (We tested with Sony DualSense, Sony DualShock 4, Xbox One/Series, Nintendo Switch Pro)
- We tested the game on Steam Deck with Proton 9.0 compatibility and it's running with a fairly stable 30 fps 


Fixes:
- Much better performance
- We compressed and removed some useless objects to drastically decrease build size (From 15.1 GB down to about 3.1 GB)
- Sound fixes to enemies and ambiance
- Many enemy fixes
- Improved loot spawning
- FX and visual tweaks for readability
- UI fixes
- Fuel now affects the bus 
- Improved chunk spawning times and distance

Thank you for the support and feedback, it really helped a lot. 

Just like last time if you find any bugs feel free to report them on steam or our discord.

It took us this long because we have been actively working on the multiplayer. We wanted to add the multiplayer to the demo but decided it would be better to do a closed beta so we can work with players more closely to fix bugs or issues they have. We'll publish more info here and on our discord when we are starting with the closed beta so keep an eye out for that.
  
And if you want to give us more support, don't forget to wishlist the game if you haven't already!

Thank you and see you in Skopje, Pioneers!

notes.title: Patch notes #3
notes.content:
Hello Pioneers,
Here are the newest fixes and features we added in the latest version of the demo:
[b]
Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]General performance fixes and optimization
[*]Boss fixes
[*]Fixed bug where ranged enemies can target the player incorrectly
[*]Fixes to various missions not working properly
[*]Fixed bug where music would continue looping in the wrong places
[*]General audio fixes
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Items and weapons that you store in the Bus Storage will be permanent and will stay in the next run
[*]Re-balance to resources and items required to craft some upgrades and weapons in DOM
[*]Players can now exit DOM directly from the drivers door when driving in first person view camera
[*]A notification for the first interaction with DOM so it's a bit harder to miss the bus in the first run
[*]More remapping options for controls
[/list]

The Skopje '83 demo will stay live for now as we continue working to bring you the best experience we want our game to provide for you.

You know the drill, if you encounter any issues, don't hesitate to post them on our discord, or the community hub right here on Steam!
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/HfXf8z7JNv]https://discord.gg/HfXf8z7JNv[/url]


See you in Skopje, Pioneers!

notes.title: The first Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Dark-1 team. 

We are so happy that people are finally able to play Skopje '83. Testing the game ourselves has many disadvantages and we have a lot of blind spots so your feedback is really helpful and very appreciated.

In the newest version we have fixed the most critical problems and bugs which include:
[list]
[*]Resources and items are way more common
[*]We fixed the RAM usage issue
[*]Enemies should no longer run to a specific point on the map on new runs
[*]Better enemy navigation around the world
[*]We fixed some missing quest interactions
[*]We fixed the missing hallway interior of a specific building
[/list]
We also did a lot minor visual and functional fixes that were not so critical.

Known issues we will be fixing in the coming days:
[list]
[*]Sometimes the LOD of the terrain will be visible when it shouldn't be.
[*]Sometimes an item with 0 stack appears in crates and the game can get stuck in loading screen. If you encounter items in crates that show 0 as the amount, do not pick them up!
[/list]

Thank you all for the great and constructive feedback, it really helps. We will do our best to fix all the issues and bugs while also adding a lot of quality of life tweaks to make your stay in Skopje as engaging it can be.
If you encounter any issues, don't hesitate to post them on our discord, or the community hub right here on steam!
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/HfXf8z7JNv]https://discord.gg/HfXf8z7JNv[/url]

See you in Skopje, Pioneers!
